_doc: PX4 parameters a client may read or write (contract 1.2, docs/CONTRATO_1_2.md section 5). Generated from src/shared/px4params.ts by npm run contracts; bridge/px4_bridge.py reads this file. read / write = weakest relay role (viewer < pilot < admin; write null = read only). never_write are regular expressions checked on top of the whitelist. Writes only while disarmed. Names and ranges of PX4 v1.17, not all verified against a running PX4.

rules.note: Geofence breach action: 1 warning, 2 hold, 3 return, 5 land. 0 (none) and 4 (terminate) are excluded.
Geofence horizontal radius from home. 0 (disabled) is excluded.
Geofence ceiling above home.
Low battery action: 2 land, 3 return at critical then land at emergency. 0 (warning only) is excluded. Values change between PX4 versions: verify in v1.17.
Data link loss timeout.
Data link loss action: 1 hold, 2 return, 3 land. 0 (disabled), 5 (terminate) and 6 (disarm) are excluded.
Manual control loss timeout (MANUAL_CONTROL from the bridge counts as RC).
Manual control loss action: 1 hold, 2 return, 3 land. The bridge sets 1 when piloting starts.
Actuator failure action: 0 disabled, 1 hold, 2 land, 3 return. 4 (terminate) is excluded. Verify the values in v1.17.
Control allocator obeys the failure injector (1). The bridge sets 1 on motor_off (docs/INVESTIGACION_FALLAS_PX4.md).
Return altitude above home.
Takeoff altitude; the bridge also writes it on every takeoff (1..50 m clamp).
Maximum horizontal speed.
Failure injection enabled (read at boot). Written by the bridge only, never by a client.
Manual control source; managed by the bridge (pilot).
Modes that ignore manual control loss.
Low battery threshold (fraction).
Critical battery threshold (fraction).
Emergency battery threshold (fraction).
Airframe id.
